company.name: Immensa
company.shortDescription: Immensa is a deep-tech manufacturing company that specializes in digital warehousing and additive manufacturing.
company.description: Immensa is a deep-tech manufacturing company that specializes in digital warehousing and additive manufacturing (3D printing) to modernize industrial spare-parts supply chains. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia, the company focuses on helping large industrial and energy companies produce spare parts on demand rather than storing large physical inventories.
